topics.label: Formation
topics.description: Whether parties reached an enforceable agreement.

topics.label: Offer And Acceptance
topics.description: Offer, acceptance, counter-offer, revocation, and communication.

topics.label: Consideration
topics.description: Bargained-for exchange, sufficiency, past consideration, and variation.

topics.label: Intention To Create Legal Relations
topics.description: Whether objectively assessed parties intended legal consequences.

topics.label: Certainty
topics.description: Certainty of parties, subject matter, price, and essential terms.

topics.label: Contract Terms
topics.description: Express terms, implied terms, incorporation, and interpretation.

topics.label: Misrepresentation
topics.description: False statements inducing contract and available remedies.

topics.label: Mistake
topics.description: Mistake as to terms, identity, subject matter, or assumptions.

topics.label: Breach
topics.description: Non-performance, defective performance, repudiation, and termination.

topics.label: Remedies
topics.description: Damages, specific performance, injunctions, rescission, and restitution.

topics.label: Privity
topics.description: Rights and liabilities of parties and third parties.

jurisdiction_guidance: Use Singapore settings, institutions, and contract-law terminology when this draft pack is selected.
Treat this pack as fixture-backed until a clean SG Contract corpus and validation overlay are implemented.

topic_hints.formation: Include offer, acceptance, certainty, intention, and chronology of communications.
topic_hints.offer_acceptance: Include the exact words or conduct alleged to be the offer, acceptance, counter-offer, or revocation.
topic_hints.consideration: Include the promised exchange and whether any promise looks past, nominal, or unsupported.
topic_hints.terms: Include how the disputed term was communicated, incorporated, or implied.
topic_hints.misrepresentation: Include the statement, falsity, reliance, inducement, and loss.
topic_hints.breach: Include the contractual obligation, performance due, alleged breach, and response.
topic_hints.remedies: Include loss, mitigation, expectation interest, and any non-damages remedy sought.
